name: rosetta-idoneal-numbers
code:
use default

is_idoneal(value: int) -> bool is
    let a mut = 1

    while 3 * a * a + 2 * a < value do
        let b mut = a + 1

        while a * b + b * (a + 1) < value do
            if (value - a * b) % (a + b) == 0 then
                let c = (value - a * b) / (a + b)

                if c > b then return false fi
            fi

            b = b + 1
        od

        a = a + 1
    od

    true
si

let idoneals = (1::1_850) |> filter(is_idoneal) |> map(n => "{n,5}")

write_line("the 65 known idoneal numbers:")

let rows = idoneals |> collect_list()

for row in 0..13 do
    write_line(rows[row * 5..row * 5 + 5] |> join(""))
od
